item.title: Independent HVAC Consulting Business Launch
item.description:
250-750 USD | # Digital Marketing / SEO / Lead Generation Expert Needed to Launch Independent HVAC Consulting Business
## Project Overview
PurAir is an established Texas HVAC company backed by more than 30 years of hands-on residential HVAC experience.
We are making a major business-model change.
**PurAir will NOT perform HVAC repairs, installations or equipment sales.**
We are repositioning the company as:
# PURAIR — INDEPENDENT RESIDENTIAL HVAC CONSULTING
Our customer is the homeowner—not the HVAC contractor.
We want homeowners to hire PurAir before making expensive HVAC decisions.
Our core message:
> **Before you spend $10,000–$30,000 on an HVAC system, get an independent expert opinion from someone who isn't trying to sell you equipment.**
Because we don't sell or install HVAC equipment, our recommendations can remain independent.
---
# Services We Intend to Market
Initial services may include:
### Independent HVAC Second Opinions
Homeowners who have been told they need an expensive repair or complete system replacement can hire PurAir for an independent assessment.
### HVAC Proposal / Estimate Review
Homeowners can submit one or multiple contractor proposals.
PurAir evaluates the proposed equipment, scope of work, sizing assumptions, duct modifications, warranties, and other important considerations.
### HVAC Quote Comparison
Homeowners receiving competing proposals can have PurAir compare the options and explain the differences in plain English.
### New-Home HVAC Performance Evaluation
Independent evaluation of HVAC performance in newly constructed homes.
Initial geographic targets include growing communities around Magnolia and Plantersville, Texas.
### Airflow / Duct / Humidity Consulting
Independent diagnosis and recommendations for comfort, airflow, duct and humidity problems.
### HVAC Replacement Planning
Help homeowners determine what type and size of HVAC system should be considered BEFORE requesting contractor bids.
### Ducted Inverter Heat-Pump Consulting
Specialized consulting involving 1-to-1 systems consisting of one ducted indoor air handler paired with one dedicated inverter outdoor heat pump.
### Generator-Compatible HVAC Consulting
Help homeowners understand HVAC electrical loads and appropriate equipment strategies when operating from standby generators.
---
# Local AND National Opportunity
We intend to initially establish PurAir locally in the Magnolia/Plantersville, Texas market.
However, we also want to develop a **national remote consulting service.**
A homeowner anywhere in the United States should eventually be able to:
**Upload HVAC proposals → Provide house/system information → Pay online → Receive an independent professional review → Schedule a video/phone consultation.**
Therefore, the marketing architecture should support both:
**LOCAL:** In-home consulting and HVAC performance evaluations.
**NATIONAL:** Remote HVAC proposal reviews, second opinions, and replacement consultations.
---
# What We Need From You
We are looking for someone capable of BUILDING the customer-acquisition system—not simply writing SEO articles.
Responsibilities include:
* Market and competitor research * Brand positioning * Keyword research * Local SEO * Google Business Profile optimization * Website architecture * Landing-page development * Conversion optimization * Google Search Console * Google Analytics 4 * Google Tag Manager * Google Ads * Call/form conversion tracking * Local geographic targeting * Lead tracking * Online booking/payment strategy * Review-generation strategy * AI-assisted marketing workflows
Experience with CallRail, Semrush/Ahrefs and CRM/automation platforms is preferred.
---
# AI EXPECTATION
We WANT AI used aggressively.
AI should reduce the cost of:
* Keyword research * Content development * Landing-page development * Ad variations * Competitor analysis * Reporting * Lead qualification * Email/SMS follow-up * Content planning
We are NOT interested in paying an agency thousands of dollars per month to manually perform work that modern AI tools can accomplish efficiently.
However, AI-generated spam, mass-produced low-quality pages, and automated backlink schemes are unacceptable.
---
# FIRST 6-MONTH OBJECTIVE
Budget for the initial validation project is approximately:
We are seeking proposals for an initial six-month market-validation project. Please recommend an appropriate budget and clearly separate your professional fees from advertising and third-party software costs. We prefer milestone-based pricing and will increase investment if the model demonstrates measurable customer acquisition.
This is NOT intended to fund a large traditional advertising campaign.
The objective is to determine whether we can profitably generate **PAYING HVAC CONSULTING CUSTOMERS**.
Our primary KPI is:
# PAID CONSULTATIONS
Secondary metrics include:
* Cost per qualified lead * Consultation booking rate * Cost per booked consultation * Customer acquisition cost * Organic commercial-intent traffic * Google Business Profile visibility * Conversion rate * Revenue generated
Traffic, impressions, and rankings alone will NOT be considered success.
---
# Phase 1 — Foundation
We expect the initial work to include:
1. Existing PurAir digital presence audit 2. Competitor analysis 3. Market/keyword research 4. Brand positioning recommendations 5. Consulting service architecture 6. Website structure 7. Conversion tracking 8. Google Business Profile strategy 9. Local SEO strategy 10. National SEO strategy 11. Lead-generation strategy 12. 6-month execution roadmap
---
# Phase 2 — Build
Create/optimize the initial high-intent pages.
Examples:
**Independent HVAC Second Opinion**
**HVAC Quote & Proposal Review**
**Compare My HVAC Quotes**
**Do I Really Need to Replace My AC?**
**New Home HVAC Performance Evaluation**
**HVAC Airflow & Humidity Consultation**
**Ducted Inverter Heat-Pump Consulting**
Each page must target a specific homeowner problem and drive toward a paid consultation.
---
# Phase 3 — Local Market Launch
Initial focus:
**Magnolia / Plantersville, Texas, and surrounding residential growth areas.**
We are particularly interested in new residential developments and homeowners purchasing newer homes.
The candidate should explain how they would establish PurAir in local search without violating Google Business Profile policies.
---
# Phase 4 — National Remote Consultation Test
Develop a simple customer funnel:
**Search → Landing Page → Upload HVAC Proposal → Pay → Schedule Consultation**
We want to test whether homeowners outside Texas will purchase remote HVAC proposal reviews and second opinions.
---
# REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTIONS
Generic proposals will be rejected.
Please answer these questions.
### 1.
A homeowner receives three HVAC replacement proposals for:
$14,000 $18,000 $23,000
How would you get that homeowner to discover PurAir BEFORE choosing a contractor?
### 2.
Give us 10 Google searches you believe that homeowner might make.
### 3.
Which would you prioritize during the first 90 days:
SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram, YouTube or another channel?
Explain why.
### 4.
How would you establish PurAir locally around Magnolia/Plantersville, Texas?
### 5.
How would your strategy change when targeting customers nationally for remote HVAC proposal reviews?
### 6.
Describe the landing page/funnel you would build for:
**“Upload Your HVAC Quote for an Independent Expert Review.”**
### 7.
What technology stack would you recommend?
We expect familiarity with:
* ChatGPT * Google Business Profile * Google Search Console * GA4 * Google Tag Manager * Google Ads * Call/form tracking * WordPress or equivalent * Semrush or Ahrefs
CRM and marketing automation experience is preferred.
### 8.
How will you prove which marketing source produced a PAID consultation?
### 9.
What would you do with a six-month validation budget?
Provide an approximate budget allocation.
### 10.
What would you NOT spend money on during the first six months?
---
# CASE STUDIES REQUIRED
Provide at least two relevant examples involving:
* HVAC * Home services * Professional consulting * High-ticket consumer services
We are interested in actual business results.
Where possible, provide:
**Ad Spend → Leads → Paid Customers → Customer Acquisition Cost → Revenue**
Screenshots or other verifiable evidence are preferred.
---
# IMPORTANT
We do NOT want:
* Mass backlink packages * Purchased reviews * Fake Google locations * Keyword-stuffed Google Business Profile names * Hundreds of AI-generated pages * Guaranteed Google rankings * Generic monthly SEO packages
We want someone capable of helping us **create and validate a new residential HVAC consulting category.**
If successful, this initial project could become a long-term relationship.
Please begin your proposal with the words:
**“INDEPENDENT HVAC”**
Applications that do not begin with those words will not be considered.

item.title: Premium Squarespace Site Consolidation and SEO Implementation
item.description:
250-750 USD | Project: Consolidate two websites into one premium Squarespace site, implement SEO/copy I've already written, and clean up scattered social media accounts.
Background: I run South Garden Service Dogs (southgardenservicedogs.com), an established Squarespace site for my premium German Shepherd training/placement business, and a separate single-page site, Elite Guardian Service Dogs (eliteguardianservicedogs.com), for my 501(c)(3) nonprofit that places service dogs with veterans and first responders. Both share the same phone number, facility, and founder, and the overlapping branding is splitting my search visibility and confusing buyers. Elite Guardian currently doesn't show up in Google at all.
The decision: Make South Garden the single public-facing site. Fold Elite Guardian in as its own dedicated 501(c)(3) program page inside South Garden — not a second site. Migrate the relevant Elite Guardian content over, then retire the old Elite Guardian site with a 301 redirect.
Audience and goal: Affluent buyers along the DC-to-Richmond/I-95 corridor purchasing premium trained German Shepherds ($15,000-$50,000 range). The primary conversion action on every page should be a booking/inquiry form submission, with phone as backup. Tone needs to be premium, trustworthy, and discreet.
What I supply: Finished page copy and SEO titles/meta descriptions for the home page, an Executive K9 consultation page, and 5-7 city landing pages, plus Elite Guardian program copy, brand facts, and updated photos/video. This is an implementation job, not a copywriting job.
What I need done (website/SEO):
Consolidate the two sites into one, build the Elite Guardian program page, set up the 301 redirect Implement my supplied copy, SEO titles, meta descriptions, image alt text Google Search Console setup, sitemap submission, crawl/indexing review LocalBusiness/Organization schema (JSON-LD) via Squarespace code injection Audit and optimize my Google Business Profile Premium design refresh, full mobile optimization Online booking integration (Squarespace Scheduling or Calendly) plus short lead forms on key pages A distinct "Request a Private Executive K9 Consultation" funnel, separate from my existing free-assessment CTA 5-7 unique city landing pages (copy provided), properly internally linked to each other and the rest of the site — no duplicate/thin content Blog structure for future content Fix footer copyright year and a few known typos Visible 501(c)(3)/EIN info on the Elite Guardian page Make "Available Puppies" prominent in the main nav and homepage header Refresh outdated photos/video with assets I provide Consolidate two separate business email inboxes into one
What I need done (social media cleanup — one-time, not ongoing management):
Audit Facebook, both Instagram profiles, TikTok, YouTube, and X/Twitter Identify and remove or merge duplicate/abandoned accounts Confirm Facebook/Instagram are properly linked and cross-posting through Meta Business Suite Standardize name, bio, contact info, and website link across every platform Document which platforms stay active vs. go dormant Confirm I retain admin access to everything before it's considered done
Important wording rule: for liability/insurance reasons, the visible website copy can never use the word "protection" — I use stability, secure, steady, confident, grounded instead. The word "protection" stays only in the SEO layer (page titles, meta descriptions, URL slugs), never in visible text.
Out of scope unless separately agreed: off-page SEO (backlink building, citations, outreach), reputation management, ranking guarantees, ongoing social media posting/management.
What I need in your quote: a firm fixed price, broken out separately for the website/SEO work and the social media cleanup, a proposed timeline with milestones, relevant samples (ideally premium/high-end service business sites, not just any Squarespace site), and confirmation you're comfortable working inside Squarespace — this is not a custom-code rebuild.

The concept is similar in some ways to NFC digital business cards. With these, a physical NFC card is linked to a unique user profile, which can be opened simply by tapping the card against a smartphone.
My idea would use the same principle, but for storing and accessing documents and images.
Each customer would receive a physical NFC card, also containing a QR code, which I am able to manufacture and programme myself. The card would be linked to that customer’s unique account.
When the customer taps the NFC card against their phone, or scans the QR code, they would be taken directly to their own simple user area. From there, they could:
- Create folders - Upload images, receipts and scanned documents - View and manage previously uploaded files - Organise their files within their account
The key part of the idea is simplicity. I don’t want users to have to remember an email address, username or password. Instead, access would be through a unique link/token associated with their physical NFC/QR card.
Ideally, without the card or its unique link, there would be no straightforward way of accessing the account.
From an admin side, I would need to be able to create and manage customer accounts, associate each account with an NFC/QR card, and potentially manage an annual subscription for the service.
I can handle the manufacture, printing and programming of the physical NFC/QR cards, so I’m mainly looking for someone who can develop the web/software side of the project.
The files being stored would primarily be things such as receipts, photographs and scanned documents rather than highly sensitive information. However, I would still want the platform to follow sensible security and data-protection practices.
The purpose of this platform is to allow vehicle enthusiasts to securely upload and store their vehicle’s data—such as invoices, receipts, repair bills, service history—in one location that can then be sold along with the vehicle. This eliminates missing information even if the NFC card is lost since hidden NFC labels could also be placed in vehicles as backups. This ensures transparency for buyers while helping avoid issues like stolen vehicles or falsified histories.
I’m initially looking to create a relatively simple MVP rather than an unnecessarily complicated system, with the possibility of developing it further if the concept proves successful. The design should reflect simplicity and intuitiveness akin to "Apple product" aesthetics—clean and user-friendly for all age groups.
Additionally: - Users should start with a fixed storage amount tied to their card but have options to expand storage if needed without incurring high costs on my end. - Attached images are included as references for my vision; these were created using non-specialized software but convey the core idea clearly.
